items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I think he had August Russo on trombone. And, uh, see on trumpet one time, Louis DeMaine, before he got his band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played with him. Oh, he had... Who did you play with? Yeah. Yeah.

I know he had Sam Dutre, Sam's father, you know. Yeah. And I think he had August Russo on trombone. And, uh, see on trumpet one time, Louis DeMaine, before he got his band. And, uh, trumpetplayer.com, live out in the country. Fine trumpet player. Used to be a male man, used to be insurance man. What is his name?
